lead: Ratan Tata was an entrepreneur, born on 28 December 1937 in Mumbai.
He died on 9 October 2024 in Mumbai at the age of 86.
He has been recognised with Knight Grand Cross of the Order of the British Empire and Maharashtra Bhushan Award.
Below you will find a verified overview of Ratan Tata: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Ratan Tata — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ratan Tata was born on 28 December 1937 in Mumbai, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India.
Public records name his father, Naval Tata and his mother, Soonoo Tata. He is a sibling of Noel Tata.
His listed education includes Harvard Business School, Cornell University College of Architecture, Art, and Planning, Riverdale Country School and Campion School, Mumbai.
He is recorded as speaking Tamil and English.

sections.heading: Ratan Tata — Career and Professional Work
paras: Ratan Tata works primarily as an entrepreneur, engineer, businessperson and philanthropist, with IBM listed among his employers.
